citation.title: Effective thermal conductivity estimation using a convolutional neural network and its application in topology optimization
citation.authors: Andre Adam, Huazhen Fang, Xianglin Li
citation.version_coded: Version of record metadata/abstract (full text inaccessible)

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: The abstract reports that CNN thermal-conductivity prediction takes 15 ms per 128 × 128 image, 3–5 orders of magnitude less time than finite-volume simulation, and is applied in topology optimization.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: Abstract states a 3–5 orders-of-magnitude comparison but no single factor; this is CNN prediction versus finite-volume simulation.
claim.alternatives: In TO applications, reported MAPE is 0.67%–11.8%, with trend prediction and improvement toward a theoretical maximum (abstract).

baseline.quality_metric: MAPE: 0.35% and 2.35% in testing; 0.67%–11.8% in TO cases (abstract)

notes: Abstract was accessible via publisher and institutional metadata. The publisher PDF endpoint and an author-uploaded ResearchGate PDF returned 403; no bot check was bypassed. No full text was available through the allowed routes. The publisher abstract reports a 15 ms prediction for 128 × 128 input and 3–5 orders of magnitude faster than finite-volume simulation.
